turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Your Honors, we are offering the testimony of Mr. Lembel G. Ortoño to qualify him as a hostile witness and to prove the following. Number one, the confidential funds answered to no legitimate confidential purpose.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: The amount was requested before the supporting plan was produced and the 2023 plan just repeated the operative language of the 2022 plan. Nauna ang 250 million, sumunod ang plano, matapos itong hingin ng DBM. Hindi plano ang nagtakda ng halaga. Ang halaga ang nauna, saka hinabol ang plano. Number two, the respondent's handprints are in every document that mattered. Mula request hanggang liquidation, Nasa mahalagang dokumento ang kanyang otoridad at pag-apruba. Number three, the reports were written to fit the rules, not the facts. Apat na ulat, iisang template. Mga halagang hindi nagbabago at laging eksaktong 125 million. Not a peso more, not a centavo less. Walang natira, Walang sinaulit. Number four. Five days after COWA questioned the medical and food aid item, the line disappeared while the report still totaled exactly 125 million. Quinestron ng Commission on Audit ang medical and food aid na may halagang 40 million, 42 million, at 40 million sa tatlong unang accomplishment reports. Makalipas ang limang araw, wala na ito sa huling accomplishment report. Pero 125 million pa rin ang kabuuhan ng halaga. Number five. In two years, not one area, not one operation was ever named. Daang-daang area ang iniulat. 500 million ang ginastos. Ngunit wala ni isang lugar, ni isang operasyon. ni isang petsa ang pinangalanan. Number six, the liquidation was late, irregular, and backdated. Sampung buwan huli ang mga resibo. Mahigit isang daan ang may petsang isang taon pagkatapos ng diumanoy bayaran. Number seven, the certifications vouched for nothing and were signed by the man who received the money. Walang untoward incident. Iyan lamang ang pinatutunayan. Walang halaga, walang pangalan, walang lugar at walang petsa. At ang pumirma, ang mismong tumanggap ng pera. Number eight. The 500 million bought protection the Vice President already had. And against threats, the AFP and the PNP were already paid billions to watch.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: 473 sundalo at polis na ang nagbabantay sa kanya. Sahod ng Republika. Mula sa ibang pondo. Walang pangalawang Pangulo sa kasaysayan ang nagkaroon ng ganito. At ang mga bantang tinutukoy sa mga ulat, ang NPA at mga teroristang grupo. Sakop na ng intelligence funds ng AFP at PNP. Bayad na ang proteksyon. Bayad na ang pagbabantay bago pa ang kahit isang piso ng confidential funds. Number nine, the justification for the confidential funds shifted with every finding. Sa DBM, safe implementation ng good governance programs, official engagements, and functional representation ng pangalawang Pangulo. Sa mga plano, confidence building. for good governance programs. At pagsapit ng 2023, socio-economic program delivery. Sa mga certifications, surveillance and information gathering to prevent and toward incidents from transpiring. Sa protective intelligence operations reports for intelligence gathering naman. Sa mga sagot sa audit observation memoranda at notices or at notice of suspension. for surveillance activities to determine where best to implement the OVP's programs. Anim na bersyon, iisang pondo. Number 10. The officials knew, answered nothing. The man who says he knew nothing, answered everything. Lahat ng sagot sa COA, pirma ng kistigong ito na ang sabi wala siyang personal na kaalaman. Ang mga tunay na nakakaalam, respondent vice president, special disbursing officer, at ang Colonel, wala ni isang sumagot. Number 11, the explanations for the confidential funds are a sham. And the failure to account the funds gives rise to the presumption of misappropriation. Pabago-bago ang paliwanag, walang detalye, walang dokumentong sumusuporta, pagtatakip, hindi pagpapaliwanag. At hanggang ngayon, hindi na-account ang 500 million ng bayan. Sa ganitong kabiguan, At atas na mismo ang nagsasalita, prima facie, na ipinalalagay na ang pondo ay ginamit para sa sariling kapakanan. That would be all for your

turns.text: Honor.

Nevertheless, we will cross-examine the witness to verify the allegations or to disprove the allegations of the prosecution.

turns.speaker: Lemuel G. Ortoño

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: And, kanina naman po kayo nagre-report nung nanulungkulan kayo bilang head of the resource, human resource department?

turns.speaker: Lemuel G. Ortoño
turns.text: As the head of the human resource, as the department head, I report directly to the mayor and as well have reportorial duties to the city administrator.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Prior to that, Mr. Ortonio, ano naman po ang inyong naging katungkulan kung meron man? City Government of Davao City.

turns.speaker: Lemuel G. Ortoño
turns.text: Prior to being the Human Resource Head, I also headed the Davao City Investment Promotion Center. That's from 2016 all the way to 2018 as well. And then in 2010 to 2013, I served as the Chief of Staff of the Office of the Mayor.

turns.speaker: Lemuel G. Ortoño
turns.text: 2008 until 2010, I served as the chief of staff under the office of the vice mayor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Isa-isa yun po natin. Noong nanungkulan kayo bilang head ng Davao City Investment and Promotion Center, sino naman po ang nanungkulan bilang mayor ng Davao City at that time?

turns.speaker: Lemuel G. Ortoño
turns.text: The mayor at the time is Vice President Sara Duterte.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Noong time naman po nanungkulan kayo bilang chief of staff, sino naman po ang nanungkulan? bilang Mayor at the time.

turns.speaker: Lemuel G. Ortoño
turns.text: It's the Vice President, Sara Z. Duterte.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: At huli, noong nanungkulan kayo noong 2008 onwards, sino naman po ang nanungkulan? Or ano, sino naman po ang nanungkulan bilang Vice Mayor at the time?

turns.speaker: Lemuel G. Ortoño
turns.text: The Vice Mayor at the time is Vice President, Sara Z. Duterte.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Now, prior to 2008, saan kayo nanungkulan o nagtatrabaho kung meron na?

turns.text: My first working experience was with the Pag-ibig Fund. That was four years and then I worked around four or about four to six months with the Davao City Chamber of Commerce.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Mr. Antonio, in October 2024, ano naman po ang mga compulsory processes, if any, na natanggap ninyo mula sa House Committee on Good Government and Public Accountability?

turns.text: sa ano-anong pecha naman po kayo inimbitahang mag-appear?
